subject: geography
title: Building Greener Cities
welcome_lead: How can your own town be greener? Discover smart ideas from public transport to smart grids.
meta_desc: KS3 Geography adventure on green city strategies, transport, recycling and smart grids.
final_note: Brilliant! You can now suggest ideas for greener cities.

concepts.def: Shared transport like buses and trains.
Electricity network that balances supply and use.
Gases released, often from burning fuel.
Streets for walkers only, no cars.
Food grown in city spaces or rooftops.

walkthroughs.body_html: Cities can cut emissions by promoting buses, trams, cycling and walking. London's congestion charge and Paris's bike-sharing schemes are good examples.
Smart grids use sensors to match electricity use with renewable supply. Combined with recycling and better insulation, cities slash waste.
Parks, green roofs and urban farms cool cities, boost biodiversity and improve mental health. Singapore is a 'garden city' role model!
